native: Return JSON with only corrected SWI-Prolog source in content. Use module miter_mattermost_bridge with surface_ingest/5, surface_effect/5, surface_reconnect/4, surface_panic/2. Every dict must use underscore-prefixed SWI syntax, for example Config = _{server_id:s1} and Outcome = _{status:accepted}; never use bare {key:value}. Use get_dict/3 for required fields and quoted atom '/api/v4/posts'. Keep immutable state with seen event-version pairs and effect-id/idempotency pairs. Authorize server/team/channel/user before reading event data. Support posted and post_edited, stable IDs, update-aware dedupe, monotone cursor, inert effect descriptor, typed rejection, reconnect and panic. No dynamic state, network, credentials, Soul, Chroma, models, or private memory. Correct the supplied runtime consequences; under 180 lines.
